answers.core: This could allow the creation of several more useful icons for the scene tree, so I think most people would benefit of it being on core than an addon.
answers.workaround: I suppose it can. I'm really not familiar with using addons to hack parts of the editor UI that are not meant to be changed, but I have a hunch it could be done with an addon.

title: Create an editor setting for selecting which icons get shown in the scene tree view
